children: JPMorgan's forecast for net-interest income in the fourth quarter came in ahead of analyst estimates.
Depending on market conditions, the bank expects $28 billion in net-interest income in the quarter. Analysts polled by FactSet expect $27.42 billion.
And for 2027, based on a preliminary analysis, JPMorgan expects about $107 billion in net-interest income excluding markets, compared with an implied 2026 guidance of $97.2 billion.
